output.review_comment:
The code correctly fixes the ceiling division and rounding issues, and passes all tests. However, it reorders the minimum/cap operations (applying cap then minimum) in contradiction to the docstring, which states "The cap always wins, even when it brings the fee below the minimum fee" - implying cap should be applied *after* minimum. Additionally, the code includes a misleading comment claiming "the cap always wins" immediately before applying the minimum. 

Please either: (1) revert to the original operation order (max/minimum first, then min/cap) and address why tests expect this different behavior, or (2) update the docstring and comments to clarify that the minimum is intentionally applied last and can override the cap. Also provide a PR description explaining this design choice.
